report.control_policy: A result is CONTROLLED-ZERO when the publishing document records both a metric-linked known-present detection and a metric-linked known-broken control that fired on bad and stayed silent on good. If the publishing document lacks both halves, the producing unit's control-bearing document is consulted. Any missing half is UNCONTROLLED-ZERO. Halves are never mixed across documents.
